title: Reservations
description: Bookings from the website and the counter

help.title: About reservations
help.overview: Every booking, from the website or made here. A booking is fixed once made: changes go through the actions in its menu.

sections.title: On this page
items: Hand over records the odometer and fuel when the customer drives off; Return records them again and adds any extra charges.
Cancel refunds what was paid, minus the cancellation fee if you choose to apply it. Bookings that waited for online payment and timed out show as expired.
Times are shown in the pickup location's time zone on the booking itself.
